wikipedia.extract: Ostriches are large flightless birds. Two living species are recognised: the common ostrich, native to large parts of Sub-Saharan Africa, and the Somali ostrich, native to the Horn of Africa.
wikipedia.title: Ostrich

wikipedia.extract: The crested partridge (Rollulus rouloul), also known as the crested wood partridge, roul-roul, red-crowned wood partridge, green wood quail, and green wood partridge is a gamebird in the pheasant family Phasianidae of the order Galliformes, gallinaceous birds. It is the only member of the genus Rollulus.
wikipedia.title: Crested partridge

commonNames.name: Pomace fly
commonNames.source: Global Register of Introduced and Invasive Species - Hawaii, United States (ver.2.0, 2022)

wikipedia.extract: Drosophila melanogaster is a species of fly (an insect of the order Diptera) in the family Drosophilidae. The species is often referred to as the fruit fly or lesser fruit fly, or less commonly the "vinegar fly", "pomace fly", or "banana fly".
wikipedia.title: Drosophila melanogaster

wikipedia.extract: Pomatostomus is a genus of small to medium-sized birds endemic to Australia-New Guinea. All four species are distributed in Australia, and only the grey-crowned babbler could also be found in south New Guinea.
wikipedia.title: Pomatostomus

wikipedia.extract: The rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta), colloquially rhesus monkey, is a species of Old World monkey in the Macaca genus. There are between six and nine recognised subspecies split between two groups, the Chinese-derived and the Indian-derived.
wikipedia.title: Rhesus macaque

wikipedia.extract: Sclerurus is a bird genus in the ovenbird family, Furnariidae. Members of this genus are commonly known as leaftossers or leafscrapers, and are found in Mexico, Central America and South America.
wikipedia.title: Sclerurus

wikipedia.extract: The crab-plover or crab plover (Dromas ardeola) is a coastal wader (shorebird). It is the only member of the genus Dromas and the family Dromadidae.
wikipedia.title: Crab-plover

wikipedia.extract: The African finfoot or Peter's finfoot (Podica senegalensis) is an aquatic bird from the family Heliornithidae (the finfoots and sungrebe). The species lives in the rivers and lakes of western, central, and southern Africa.
wikipedia.title: African finfoot

wikipedia.extract: Nyctidromus is a genus of nightjars in the family Caprimulgidae. The species are widely distributed in Central and South America.
wikipedia.title: Nyctidromus

wikipedia.extract: Paracathartes is a genus of extinct bird from the Wasachtian horizon of lower Eocene Wyoming. One species, Paracathartes howardae has been described.
wikipedia.title: Paracathartes
